notes.title: V1.03 SUBTITLE UPDATE!!!
notes.content: I've added English subtitles to Hell of a Birthday to help make the game a little more accessible. Hope you all enjoy!

notes.title: Update V1.02
notes.content:
Another small bug fix update
-Fixed the pause menu being able to open during the main menu which led to more problems

notes.title: Update V1.01
notes.content:
Thank you everyone who has played my game so far. The reception has been amazing. I did come across a few bugs that needed to be fix so this is what the update is about.

- Fixed option menu cursor being locked after the game starts.
- Fixed players getting stuck behind couch after animal fight scene.
- Adjusted object collision to help avoid items falling through counters.

If you have come across any other issues please let me know. I made a bugs post in the discussions where you can make fun of me if you want. Hope you've all had fun with the latest game!
